full_text:
Probate-Sisco
Preserved Primary Document • probt-s6.htm
Be it remembered that on the thirteenth day of February one thousand eight hundred and twenty six, Letters of Administration on the estate of Rachel Sisco deceased to Thomas Carney Junior who being sworn gave bond with Simon (unclear) as his surety on One Hundred dollars.
Bond Administration Papers mention :
Thomas Carney Jr. of Appoquiniminck Hundred, New Castle Co.
Simon Shearman
Rachel as wife of Isaiah Sisco
